gates.question: How does the gap expert tell a broad question, whose topic words only fit inside a narrower gap entry's title, from one that names the gap's own missing fact?
options: The question's topic words must hold at least a third of the title's weight, a word weighing its inverse document frequency over the kb's units, so a title's rare words count more than its common ones; a gap entry that fails it is left to the plain pack
The gap answers only when the plain pack is not good on the article the gap's topic marker names
The question must hold a fixed share of the title's words, every word counting once
gates.recommendation: The question's topic words must hold at least a third of the title's weight, a word weighing its inverse document frequency over the kb's units, so a title's rare words count more than its common ones; a gap entry that fails it is left to the plain pack
